classification.difficultyReason: Combines finance charges, reverse simple interest, depreciation and average vehicle running costs.

content.prompt: The cash price of a car is advertised as $\$32\,000$. Alternatively you can buy the car with a deposit of 40% and repayments of $\$377.60$ per month for 5 years to a finance company.

children.label: a
children.prompt: What is the price paid for the car under the alternative scheme?

children.label: b
children.prompt: What is the amount of interest paid to the finance company under the alternative scheme?

children.label: c
children.prompt: What is the rate of simple interest p.a. that will apply in the alternative scheme?

answer.worked:
The principal is the amount financed after the deposit.

$$\begin{align*}P&=32\,000-12\,800\\P&=19\,200\\I&=PRT\\3456&=19\,200\times R\times5\\3456&=96\,000R\\R&=\frac{3456}{96\,000}\\R&=0.0216\end{align*}$$

The simple interest rate is 2.16% p.a.

children.label: d
children.prompt: The car depreciates in value by 12% per year.

children.label: i
children.prompt: Find the value of the car at the end of the 5 years, to the nearest dollar.

answer.worked:
Each year the car retains 88% of its previous value.

$$\begin{align*}\text{Value after 5 years}&=32\,000\times(0.88)^5\\\text{Value after 5 years}&=16\,887.4213376\\\text{Value after 5 years}&\approx\$16\,887\end{align*}$$

children.label: ii
children.prompt: Calculate your average total cost per month over the 5-year period if you use the Finance Company option. Include interest and depreciation, and assume that it costs $\$1000$ per year for comprehensive insurance and registration, $\$200$ per month for petrol and $\$800$ per year for servicing. Give your answer to the nearest cent.

answer.short:
$\$659.48$ per month.

Add depreciation, interest and running costs, then divide by 60 months.
answer.worked:
Use the unrounded value from part d(i).

$$\begin{align*}\text{Depreciation}&=32\,000-32\,000(0.88)^5\\\text{Depreciation}&=15\,112.5786624\\\text{Insurance and registration}&=1000\times5\\\text{Insurance and registration}&=\$5000\\\text{Petrol}&=200\times60\\\text{Petrol}&=\$12\,000\\\text{Servicing}&=800\times5\\\text{Servicing}&=\$4000\\\text{Total cost}&=15\,112.5786624+3456+5000+12\,000+4000\\\text{Total cost}&=39\,568.5786624\\\text{Average monthly cost}&=\frac{39\,568.5786624}{60}\\\text{Average monthly cost}&\approx\$659.48\end{align*}$$
